title: Overreact
subtitle: Overreact = react more strongly, emotionally, seriously, or drastically than the situation
description: Overreact = react more strongly, emotionally, seriously, or drastically than the situation reasonably requires。 替換時要先分清：是 反應強度過高、把 reaction 本身放大、把事情看得太嚴重、把小問題鬧大、還是採取了過度行動。

words.example: She responded too strongly to a relatively minor mistake.
words.exampleZh: 她對一個相對輕微的錯誤反應過度。

exercises.original: I think he overreacted to a fairly harmless comment.
exercises.zh: 我覺得他對一句相當無害的評論反應太強烈。
exercises.upgrade: A. Respond too strongly · 反應過度；反應太強烈

options.explanation: Respond too strongly ✓ — respond with more emotion, force, concern, or action than a situation requires。本句的關鍵是 the response is stronger than the comment warrants；因此 Respond too strongly 最精準地保留這種 overreact 的意思。
React excessively — react in an excessive way beyond what circumstances justify。react excessively 是正式的廣義替代；若句子明確聚焦『把事情看得太重』、把小事鬧大或採取過度行動，另有更精準表達。
Make too much of — treat something as more important or serious than it really is。make too much of 強調把某件事看得過於重要；如果重點是純粹 emotional intensity，會改變焦點。
Panic — become suddenly very frightened and unable to think calmly。panic 是特定的恐慌反應；人可以過度生氣、過度限制或過度擔心而完全沒有 panic。
Complain — express dissatisfaction。complain 只是表達不滿，本身不代表程度過分。
Get angry — become angry。get angry 只說生氣；生氣也可以完全合乎比例。

options.explanation: Respond too strongly — respond with more emotion, force, concern, or action than a situation requires。respond too strongly 很接近，但較一般；若題目要求正式分析、誇大 reaction 或把小問題鬧大，另有更精準答案。
Blow out of proportion — make a problem or event seem much more serious or important than it is。blow out of proportion 要有某個 issue/problem 被誇大；純情緒反應或一般 excessive action 不一定合。
Panic — become suddenly very frightened and unable to think calmly。panic 是特定的恐慌反應；人可以過度生氣、過度限制或過度擔心而完全沒有 panic。
Complain — express dissatisfaction。complain 只是表達不滿，本身不代表程度過分。
Get angry — become angry。get angry 只說生氣；生氣也可以完全合乎比例。
Go overboard ✓ — do or react more strongly or extremely than necessary or sensible。本句的關鍵是 behaviour goes beyond what is sensible；因此 Go overboard 最精準地保留這種 overreact 的意思。

falseSynonyms.zh: 驚慌 ≠ overreact panic 是一種特定恐慌反應；人可以 overreact 而不 panic。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Panic is one specific reaction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 誇大 ≠ automatically overreact exaggerate 可以誇大事實、數字或故事，不一定是反應過度。
投訴 ≠ overreact complain 只是表達不滿，程度可以完全合理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Complaining is not necessarily excessive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 生氣 ≠ overreact 生氣本身不代表反應過度；要看程度是否超出情境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Anger can be proportionate.

falseSynonyms.zh: 誇大陳述 ≠ overreact overstate 多指把重要性、數量、風險說得太高，不直接表示行為反應。
只在『做得過火』sense 接近 go overboard 範圍比 overreact 廣，可指花錢、裝飾、準備等過度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Go overboard is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在『把事情看得太嚴重』sense 接近 它要求有一件事被誇大，而不是任何形式的情緒反應。
詞性陷阱 overreact 是動詞；overreaction 是名詞。
